The '''Anturi Reach''' was a trade route that stretched from [[Karfeddion/Legends|Karfeddion]] in the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]] to the [[Nothoiin Corridor]]. The planet [[Yetoom Na Uun]] was located on the Anturi Reach.
